ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of Medicaid fraud schemes to identify potential patterns and connections between entities.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
How can law enforcement improve oversight and monitoring of Medicaid claims?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of Medicaid fraud schemes, we can identify potential patterns and connections between entities and better understand the scope of the issue.
